Settings


Use your own TMDB API key to load shows and trailers.
  1. Create or sign in to your TMDB account.
  2. Open Settings → API in a desktop browser and request an API key. Complete TMDB’s application and accept its terms.
  3. Copy your API Key (v3 auth) and paste it below. Use the API key, not the longer API Read Access Token.




Saved in this browser on this device and sent only to TMDB for API requests. Your key is never included in downloaded launcher copies. Moving or renaming a local HTML file, changing browsers, or clearing browser data may require entering it again.
